resources.string: Gradey uses encrypted local storage and only registers push tokens after notification permission is granted.
Keep your linked school accounts and school information together.
This build only supports demo data. To connect your own school account, install a version with live sign-in enabled.
Use your Google account to create or open a Gradey ID. School passwords stay encrypted on this device. Linked school sessions are encrypted in your Gradey account.
Choose how to sign in to your Gradey ID. Use the same sign-in method you used on your other devices.
Already use Gradey on iPhone? Sign in with Apple to open the same account, including when you used Hide My Email.
